title: cymboglossum zamboangense
intro: Cymboglossum zamboangense, commonly known as Zamboanga creeping fern, is a type of flowering plant in the family Dennstaedtiaceae. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin infections, due to its health benefits of reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Cymboglossum zamboangense include antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids and phenolic acids. Further research is needed to confirm the full scope of its medicinal properties and potential applications.
